repos_data.description: Control Gmail, Google Calendar, Docs, Sheets, Slides, Chat, Forms, Tasks, Search & Drive with AI - Comprehensive Google Workspace MCP Server & CLI Tool

Curated MCP server for Google Workspace: Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Sheets, Docs, and Tasks via the official gws CLI. 67 focused tools instead of 400, side effects declared on every one. The permissions leg of trust infrastructure for agents.
Multi-account Google Workspace MCP server — Gmail, Calendar, and Drive with smart routing. Plugin for Claude Code and Gemini CLI.
Google Workspace MCP that actually writes. 28 tools across Docs/Slides/Sheets/Drive — markdown-to-Docs, smart chips, data validation, recursive folder copy, revision restore.
Local MCP server for Gmail — send/search/label with your data staying between your machine and Google
